privacy_guarantees: Zero browser cookies, fingerprinting, or cross-site identifiers.
Stores aggregate daily counters only (YYYY-MM-DD + event + page_slug + target_key); never logs IP addresses or raw User-Agent strings.
Inert on static GitHub Pages until window.COUNTERTOP_COLLECTOR_URL is set to an approved first-party HTTPS origin.

events.name: page_view
events.trigger: Document load on any published HTML page when DNT/GPC are not enabled.
events.purpose: Count aggregate daily page entries across storefront, category, guide, and desk pages.

events.name: product_card_click
events.trigger: Reader clicks a sponsored Amazon CTA on a storefront, category, comparison, or product dossier card.
events.purpose: Measure outbound product click interest per item without user-level tracking or dynamic sub-tags.

events.name: guide_to_product_click
events.trigger: Reader clicks from an editorial buying guide to a product dossier or outbound sponsored product link.
events.purpose: Identify which question-shaped and seasonal guides assist product evaluation.

events.name: comparison_filter_use
events.trigger: Reader toggles a workflow, category, or counter-footprint filter on the storefront or Compare page.
events.purpose: Learn which buyer constraints (dual-zone timing, single-layer width, sheet-pan oven, leave-in probe) matter most.

events.name: suggestion_decision
events.trigger: Operator clicks Approve, Hold, or Reject on a suggestion card in the Suggestions Review Queue.
events.purpose: Record aggregate governance review actions before implementing site or prompt changes.
